close_reason: require_rfc822_san field added to ValidationPolicy; SmimeProfile sets it; 3 new tests
description: The require_subject_alt_name flag in smime_policy only checks that a non-empty SAN extension is present. It does not verify the SAN contains an rfc822Name entry. A certificate with only a dNSName SAN passes the check. The specific SAN type needs to be validated for S/MIME correctness.
title: pkix-profiles: smime_policy SAN type not validated (dNSName passes rfc822 check)
